sn25.2:1.8: yo bhikkhave ime dhamme evaṃ saddahati adhimuccati. ayaṃ vuccati saddhānusārī okkanto sammattaniyāmaṃ sappurisabhūmiṃ okkanto vītivatto puthujjanabhūmiṃ
sn25.2:1.9: abhabbo taṃ kammaṃ kātuṃ yaṃ kammaṃ katvā nirayaṃ vā tiracchānayoniṃ vā pittivisayaṃ vā upapajjeyya
sn25.2:1.10: abhabbova tāva kālaṃ kātuṃ yāva na sotāpattiphalaṃ sacchikaroti.
sn25.2:2.1: yassa kho bhikkhave ime dhammā evaṃ paññāya mattaso nijjhānaṃ khamanti. ayaṃ vuccati dhammānusārī okkanto sammattaniyāmaṃ sappurisabhūmiṃ okkanto vītivatto puthujjanabhūmiṃ
sn25.2:2.2: abhabbo taṃ kammaṃ kātuṃ yaṃ kammaṃ katvā nirayaṃ vā tiracchānayoniṃ vā pittivisayaṃ vā upapajjeyya
sn25.2:2.3: abhabbova tāva kālaṃ kātuṃ yāva na sotāpattiphalaṃ sacchikaroti.
